koma.help_effect: Special Gauge regenerates when you're on the field

koma.support_effect: Yusuke stands for about a sec, then starts comboing into a final punch that guard breaks. Damage: 26(power/laughter), 33(knowledge). Guide opinion: 'VERY USEFUL! this is a commonly used support by tons of people, the guard break can also give you time to use a special.'

Yusuke charges his fist for approximently 2 sec, then fires out a spirit shotgun that shots forwards, up, and down (both up and down are shot at a 45 degree angle). Guide opinion: 'meh, to slow to combo break and your opponent will more than likely defend before it fires, i recomend the 2 koma still.'

moves.name: ultimate action
moves.description: Yusuke charges up (hold for a couple seconds). Y attacks will do more damage and his forward+Y attack will have more range.
moves.quote: select -ultimate action-Yusuke charges up(Hold for a couple seconds. Y attacks will do more damage and his forward + Y attack will have more range.)-

moves.description: Basic combo string examples given in the combos section: B, forward+B, Y; B, forward+B, Y, forward+Y; B, forward+B, up+Y; B, up+B, (aerial)B or (aerial)Y; B, forward+B, up+B, (aerial)Y.
moves.quote: B, forward+B, Y : a quick little combo, not much but still good.

moves.name: The Almighty Yusuke Combo
moves.description: B, Y, up+Y, then a blank finisher that is usually demon Yusuke, a spirit gun (special or non-special), or a support. Most of these combos can have a spirit gun (X button) at the end.
moves.quote: The Almighty Yusuke Combo: B, Y, up+Y, ________(LOOK BELOW!) NOTE:the blank is usually, demon yusuke, a spirt gun(special/non special), or a support. *Most of these combos can have a spirit gun(X button) at the end.

combos: B, forward+B, Y : a quick little combo, not much but still good.
B, forward+B, Y, forward+Y : just like the first one but with more oomph.
B, forward+B, up+Y : once again, just a quick combo
B, up+B, (aerial)B or (aerial)Y : this combo may not work out every time you use it so be aware of that.
B, forward+B, up+B, (aerial)Y : pretty good combo, but theres a short pause between the forward+B and up+B.
The Almighty Yusuke Combo: B, Y, up+Y, ________(LOOK BELOW!)

Dodge this!: you'll need Hien(SAKIGAKE!! OTOKOJUKU)- 3 koma, after using a basic combo activate this guy, takes a sec to start but he lands 4 hits, fourth hit giving the enemy the satus of paralyisis, the charge p a spirt gun and let 'er rip. this combo deals around 91-100 damage to pow/laugh and 150ish to knowledge.

Suppppppppper!: for this combo you'll need Franky(one piece)- 3 koma, again using a basic combo activate franky while using Y, while he swing s his arm use up+Y, leaving franky an open shot dealing a whooping 76 damage to pow/laugh/know

Yusuke Rendan: For this combo, you'll need naruto(naruto...duh)-3koma, just any b attacks leading to Y will work, when you hit Y use naruto and he'll ollow through. WARNING: this is a combo still in testing, somtimes naruto will not completly use naruto renden, be aware.
